init_weights_model: initialize a PyTorch model with pretrained weights from a checkpoint file path
shot_acc_few_shot: calculate few-shot accuracy metrics split by many, median, and low-shot class thresholds
logits2entropy_uncertainty: compute entropy from model logits to measure prediction uncertainty for each sample
